book.title: Epesa Pâlaŋ Epesa am nâmkiŋpepeŋinmak ekŋengat zapat meluwaŋ kapi kumindaye

content: Nin busatnanen etaŋ mambanup
In Kawawaŋgat nemunambaŋane penaŋ ikŋaŋ gogot mamimindein keyepmti in Biwin Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ mama main sakam keboŋak penaŋ mamayet mulupmaŋ mbep.

Amnaŋ yominaŋgat nâmti soŋgom Kawawaŋgat sâpe sâpe bume zim pilik sesik dolakŋaŋ peme nâmti yomin makatikpemtan sepem kegogak Kilaisiyaŋ ningat gogot penaŋ mti ningalen yom pumti tep palen gakime Kawawaŋaŋ ek ekti nâme dolakŋaŋ penaŋ beye keyepmti nin Kilaisiyaŋ mge keyet katnanen gogot palen mamti dopmaŋ mukulem mukulem mti mambanup.
Keyepmti nin Kawawaŋgalen am maŋge penaŋ manup nin imbimak set kileŋ mama tamaŋ mamaipnok mamayet zet kelakŋaŋ ma nolineyelen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋgat eyak kileŋ ku mbanup.
In zet sakambukŋaŋmak ma zet mgasik notnaŋ ma zet sambuŋ mee ke zeme ŋep penaŋ ku bewe. Kawawaŋgat wisikŋ zet keboŋ keboŋ etaŋ zemti mame keyaŋ dolakŋaŋ bewe.

In penaŋ kapigok nâmbep, an imbimak set kileŋ tamaŋ maipnok maip ma zet sambuŋ manzeip ma amgalen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋgat eyak mamip ekŋen ke nopiom pedondom samti keyet otnâpeŋ maip ekŋen keyaŋ Kilaismak Kawawaŋ ekŋengalen zemâtâtât katnanen mama keyet keŋan ku mebep.

Am notnaŋaŋ in tetimindemti mama mimi bekananeset indatimti mesât zet kelakŋaŋ mimindame in zelin ke ku nâmbep. Muluwaŋ bekanaŋ keboŋ keyepmti Kawawaŋaŋ am zet kululutoŋ ekŋen keboŋ ke ŋenzinziŋ mimindamti dopmaŋ mutumindawe.
Keyepmti in am ekŋen keboŋmak oloŋkati ku mamambep.

In eweŋan tambusosokgalen mama mimi bekanaŋ ke timti mmamkwabien. Yaŋ alak pi Amobotnaŋmagen kot tusumti egalen am maŋge bemti busatnanen mamaip. Keyepmti in am maŋgeŋene itnaŋaŋ nin mamanup sepem kegogak mambep.
Am busatnanen mamaip ekŋenmagen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ kapigok masokbein. Ekŋenaŋ mama mimi dolakŋaŋ mti zelin penaŋ penaŋak zemti mama mimiŋin kwetetepmaŋ mti mamaip.
Kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ ekmâtâti Amobotnaŋaŋ nâmindeme ŋep bembeyelen keboŋ keboŋ etaŋ mbep.
In am tambusosogalen mama mimi bekanaŋ mamip ekŋen kemak met tusumti ku mambep. In naman met am bekakan ekŋen ke indatimti busatnanen kobep.
Mama mimi bekanaŋ ekŋenaŋ enzilimti mamimelip keboŋ ke zetnaŋ sosok kawaŋaŋ zemkawaŋ bembeyelen ŋep yek keyepmti neŋ zet kapi zenzeyet nâma sakambukŋaŋmak bein.
Am sambe mama miminn dolakŋaŋ ma bekanaŋ mamimenzili mâtnup bee Amobotnaŋgalen busatnaŋ keŋan sosok kot sokbemkawaŋ beme nin ekmâtâbanup. Keyet zet apapalak ŋen Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen zenzeŋaŋ,

content.text: “An muluk toŋ geŋ ilak wat. An gakikiŋanok mawenik geŋ wapmane Kilaisiyelen busatnaŋaŋ mbusatnaŋ bemgek.” (Aizaya 60:1)

content: In mama mimiŋin weyaŋ eksemti mbep in am nânâŋinpiŋ seoŋ ekŋenaŋ mamti mamip sepem keboŋ ku mammambep in am nânâŋinmak sepem keboŋ mambep.
Kan pigogat bekanaŋaŋ msalen palakŋaŋ beyeyaŋ tazingat kan isikŋaŋ bugan taindain kataŋ Kawawaŋgalen mulup windeŋaŋ bemti mbep.
In am seoŋ sepem ku mambep. Amobotnaŋaŋ mulup maindain ke ekmâtâti mbep.
In wain tu katikŋaŋ omba ku nimbep keyaŋ ŋoktikŋin mme yuŋgume bekanaŋ sambe mmebepgat e bam kumpemti Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋaŋ nâmpeme egaŋ indadamuŋ mbe.
In ilinak silik Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen tazin ke tim kukuŋaŋ ke kuwep ma silik notnaŋ Zisas milim kukuŋaŋ ke kumti sesewat silik notnaŋ kumti Amobotnaŋinaŋgat keŋ oloŋen nâmti sesewatpewep.
Amobotnaŋ Zisas Kilais egapmti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ mamimambep kataŋ Kawawaŋ Biwinaŋgat wisikŋ zepeŋ mamambep.
Awembiŋ ekŋengalen zet
In Kilaisiyet kwitnaŋ mwatonzemti zetnaŋ maŋgawepup sepem kegogak ŋenaŋ ŋengat eksempem eksempem mti mambep.
Amobotnaŋ Zisasi eksempemti manâmkiŋpeip keyet penaŋaŋ imbi in kegogak awine eksemindewep.

An in imbiŋaŋgat ŋokŋin nemboŋ sakam kegogak Kilaisiyaŋ dapmelaŋgeŋane ekŋengat ŋokŋin nemboŋ mamain. Kilaisiyet setnaŋ betnaŋ mee e dapmelaŋgeyet ŋokŋaŋ tazin e eneyet Kilaisiyaŋ ikŋaŋ yomengatnan gilik zemti ndatiye.
Âpme dapmelaŋgeŋane ekŋenaŋ Kilais eksempemti manâmkiŋpeip sepem kegogak imbi in awine eksemindewep.
Âpme an in imbiŋine ekŋen gogot mimindawep. Sepem kegogak Kilaisiyaŋ dapmelaŋgeŋane nin kegogak gogot mimndamti gilik zemndatitiyet nâmti ikŋaŋgat mamaŋaŋ ke ketalasiye.
Egaŋ kegok ke mti am nin egalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ ke nâmti nâmkiŋpepe aikmann yom zulut kapupme mepme tu zuluti Kawawaŋgat zapaletaŋ mamayet zet zapatnaŋ mandiindoip keyet kataŋ mamambep.
Egaŋ nin ndatimti met kandaŋan penaŋ maŋgeŋane penaŋ bemti mamann egaŋ ikŋaŋ nin ndikdamuŋ mimndeme nin yom mimipiŋ ma kwileki ŋen ku myuŋguwanup belak kwetetepmaŋ piliwilinaŋ piyaŋ mamambanup.
Keyepmti an in ilinaŋgat sekŋin ekdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mamip sepem kegogak imbiŋine indikdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mimindemti gogot mimindawep. An ŋenaŋ imbiŋaŋgat gogot msawe beme ikŋaŋgat mbe.

Nin an ŋenaŋ ikŋaŋgat sekŋaŋ kasa mpeme ku maeknup. Egaŋ sekŋaŋ ekdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mpemti tu meu dolakŋaŋ masain. Âpme dapmelaŋge nin Kilaisiyet setnaŋ betnaŋ mee ke bemti mamanup keyepmti egaŋ dapmelaŋgeŋane ningat sepem kegogak mamimndain.
Keyepmti Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen pigok zenzeŋaŋ,

content.text: “An ŋenaŋ mamaŋ bipmaŋ katimidemti meti imbiŋaŋ wati ekmak pepep bemti am kwepnok bemamalup.” (Sokbembe 2:24)

content: Zet Kilaismak dapmelaŋgeŋane ningat zenzeŋaŋ kapi yaŋaŋ nukŋaŋ penaŋ tazin.
An in ilinaŋgat sekŋin ekdamuŋ mti maweyaŋpeip sepem kegogak imbiŋine ekŋen gogot mimindawep. Âpme imbi in awineyet eksemindewep.
